title: Fall Detection (Wrist-worn)
description: Detect falls in less active individuals, such as elderly people, using a wrist-worn accelerometer.
long_description: This project allows you to build models to detect a fall using an IMU (Inertial Measurement Unit - accelerometer and gyroscope) mounted on the wrist.
